text:
hana: Quick follow-up from today's design review for Compliance > Retention panel. Found a few distinct accessibility and copy issues around region labels, KMS badging, and audit timestamps. Dropping notes here.
owen: I added three KMS badge treatments in the figma board: icon-only, short "Customer KMS", and full "Customer-managed key (KMS)". Link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/kms-badges
tess: Prefer short label in table rows to avoid wrapping. Full phrasing in details flyout. Important: never use unexplained acronyms like BYOK in main lists.
noor: Accessibility: lock icon + pale-blue badge is below AA for contrast. Recommendation: swap icon to #0B1220 or add 1px neutral border. Also ensure badge has an aria-label like "Key ownership: Customer-managed, region us-east-1".
hana: Copy/legal: avoid UI text implying Redwood can access key material. Suggested tooltip microcopy: "Customer-managed KMS. Only key metadata is shown; key material remains in customer KMS." Flagged for legal review.
owen: On ARNs: do not display full ARNs in lists. Redaction pattern suggestion: show `arn:...:key/••••-A1B2` and reveal last 8 chars in secure export only.
tess: Timestamps: product prefers relative times but compliance requires absolute ISO with tz. Propose inline compact pattern: `2026-12-01 14:05 (UTC) — 2h ago` and tooltip with full ISO `2026-12-01T14:05:03+00:00`. Keeps rows single-line.
noor: Focus order issue: DOM order currently mismatches visual order for Region -> Retention -> KMS badge. Fix DOM order so keyboard/tab sequence matches visual layout; ensure aria-describedby helper text remains in DOM when collapsed.
audit-bot: policy-scan: found draft copy string "we retain customer keys" in artboard.png:line 8. Severity: high. Suggested replacement: "Redwood does not have access to key material." Legal review required.
hana: Action items: 1) Owen to add compact badge + tooltip copy variants (EOD) 2) Tess to mock inline timestamp pattern and share CSV preview (tomorrow) 3) Noor to file contrast + DOM-order PR and run axe checks (PR in review) 4) Legal to review suggested microcopy from audit-bot. Blocking staging until text locked.
owen: Will add a sample export row in figma notes showing `timestamp_utc_iso`, `timestamp_local`, `kms_key_redacted`, and `kms_key_export_hash`.
tess: Also note for devs: when rendering combined UTC+relative text, use a data-order attribute with the epoch for table sorting.
hana: Thanks all — if anyone wants a quick call I can set up 10m. Otherwise please leave comments here and in figma. :thumbsup:
